summary: Paczka 8 testing (backend + frontend). Backend: new pytest tests/test_iter58_paczka8.py has 15 tests: 14 passed, 1 skipped because no profile has role=admin. Covered: soft verification (403 email_not_verified on listing and message, car add allowed), bad verify token 400, the 4th resend in an hour returns 429, retention/run 404, limits max_vehicles=8, listing-draft has no links, /ai/describe 503, admin users fields, filters and bulk-delete. Frontend: most Paczka 8 items work: garage order, verify banner/modal/resend/dismiss, private and 404 public pages, /v short link, vehicle limit modal + 'Daj mi znać', FAB ask-ai, AI beta text, ?tab=ai, listing prefill + ai-desc block + 503 toast, 'Sprzedający'/'Brak zdjęcia', footer, admin users, gtag + consent default denied. Inputs are 16px and the viewport meta has no maximum-scale. FAILURES: (1) mobile horizontal overflow is not solved: content is still wider than the screen and is only clipped by html/body overflow-x:hidden; (2) GA4 sends 2 page_view hits per SPA route change; (3) the /verify-email page shows 'invalid link' even though verification succeeded; (4) the vehicle limit-modal title showed a raw '{{limit}}' (I fixed this); (5) the 7-photo limit for listings can be bypassed.

minor.issue: Not idempotent: a second call with an already-used token for an already-verified user returns 400. Together with the frontend double-call, this shows 'Link jest nieprawidłowy' after a successful verification. Suggest returning {ok:true, already_verified:true} when the token is used and the user is already verified.
There is no server-side cap on photos[] length, so the beta photo limit (7) is only enforced in the client.

The filter treats a missing last_active as inactive, but the inactive_days column falls back to created_at. Recently created legacy users without last_active would appear in the 'inactive >30 days' filter.

ui_bugs.issue: At 360/375/390px the right-hand cluster (search, PL switcher, messages, bell, avatar) needs about 404px. topbar-profile ends at right=404px, so the avatar is cut off at the screen edge (visible in screenshots). body.scrollWidth=404 on /garage, /garage/new, /marketplace, /marketplace/{id}. It is only hidden by html,body{overflow-x:hidden}. Fine at 414px.

ui_bugs.issue: [data-testid=vehicle-title] (vehiq-display text-4xl) is 755px wide with right=771 for the long unbroken model name. The title is visibly clipped ('VolkswagenSuperdługana…'). There is also a SPAN.text-sm in the overview, 358px wide, with right=455. Add break-anywhere / min-w-0 on the flex parent.
Same unbroken-title clipping, body.scrollWidth=771. The header logo is also cramped against the 'Kopiuj link' button at 360px.
A long model name is clipped inside the card (overflow-hidden) with no wrap or ellipsis at 375px.

useEffect calls POST /auth/verify-email twice (React.StrictMode in index.js). The first call returns 200 and verifies the account, the second returns 400, and the page ends on verify-page-bad 'Link jest nieprawidłowy lub wygasł'. Reproduced with a real token: the DB has email_verified=true but the UI says invalid. Fix: add a useRef guard so the request is sent only once, plus backend idempotency.

The title was rendered as 'Wersja beta: do {{limit}} aut' because t() was called without {limit}. I fixed it in components/PremiumLimitModal.js (line 31) and verified the photos modal now shows 'do 7 zdjęć'.

The prefill from the garage correctly caps photos at 7 and shows limit-modal-photos. But the user can then tick more garage photos (I selected 8 of 9) with no modal or toast, because maxPhotos={10} is passed in CreateListing.js:652. The text 'Z profilu pojazdu — zaznacz które użyć' and the toast 'Max N zdjęć' are hardcoded in Polish (not i18n).
The verify-modal opens correctly, but a generic 'Błąd' error toast also appears at the same time. The catch block should skip the toast when detail.code === 'email_not_verified'.

integration_issues.issue: The dataLayer has exactly 1 manual page_view per route, so the hook is correct. But the network shows 2 /g/collect en=page_view hits per SPA navigation (initial load: 1). Reproduced with real Link clicks: login→register→login gave 5 hits for 3 routes. Root cause: GA4 Enhanced Measurement 'page changes based on browser history events' is on, and the manual page_view comes on top of it. Fix: turn that option off in the GA4 Data Stream settings, or stop sending manual route page_views (send_page_view:false only affects config).

issues: Because html, body, #root have height:100% and body has overflow-x:hidden, BODY becomes the scroll container (body.scrollHeight 2370 / clientHeight 812, window.scrollY is always 0). Any window.scrollY / window.scrollTo / scroll-restoration code is effectively a no-op. On iOS this also affects address-bar collapse. It hides overflow instead of fixing it. Consider overflow-x:clip on html only, or removing height:100%.
Uses the native <input type=date> (shows mm/dd/yyyy in the PL locale) instead of a shadcn calendar.
A brand-new user sees 'Witaj ponownie' ('welcome back').
Name sort is case-sensitive (lowercase names sort before uppercase). A first click on a new column sorts descending.

critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/index.css:54 + :202: height:100% together with overflow-x:hidden on body makes body the scroller and only masks the overflow

pages/CreateListing.js:652: maxPhotos={10} is hardcoded and inconsistent with the beta limit of 7; capPhotos reads `lim` from the closure, which may still be null at prefill time (falls back to 7, OK)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST users (test_p8ui-*, test_p8sel-*, test_p8reg-*, test_p8bulk*, test_p8-*), 9 TESTP8 vehicles, 1 TEST_P8 listing, a premium_waitlist entry and one email_verifications row. All were deleted by id afterwards (verified 0 remaining). Side effects on the existing user p8w-2ddff6@example.com: tooltips_seen set to true via PUT /auth/me (to dismiss the overlay), and a few verification resend e-mails/rows were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login in the browser by setting localStorage 'sharago_token' (user JWT) or 'sharago_admin_token' (admin JWT from POST /api/admin/login) plus 'sharago_cookie_consent', then reload once. Navigate with history.pushState + popstate. Note: the synthetic popstate itself can trigger an extra GA history page_view, so use Link dispatch_event('click') for GA tests. Set tooltips_seen=true via PUT /api/auth/me to avoid the first-use-tooltips overlay. The cookie banner intercepts clicks; use dispatch_event. To measure overflow, check body.scrollWidth and element rects (documentElement.scrollWidth is masked by overflow-x:hidden). To test the verify-email success path, insert an email_verifications row {user_id, token_hash: sha256(token), used:false, expires_at ISO} for a TEST user.
rca of the issue: Verify page 'invalid' after success: React.StrictMode runs the useEffect twice; the first POST consumes the token (200, email_verified=true), the second gets 400 and its catch sets state='bad' (backend log shows 200 followed by 400). GA duplicates: the manual page_view in usePageTracking plus GA4 Enhanced Measurement history-change page_view, which gives 2 /g/collect hits per pushState. Mobile overflow: the fixed-width TopBar cluster (~207px + hamburger/logo) and unbreakable long vehicle titles exceed the viewport; overflow-x:hidden on html/body hides the scrollbar but clips the content.
